oldTestStatus: EXPOSED_REGRESSION_ONLY: colony63 and FSC1189 have been viewed and cannot be re-labelled as new blind tests.

findings.conclusion: One species contributes94.96% of objects. Micro AP/P/R hide very weak recall for the other morphologies; object-weighted scores are not whole-image counting accuracy.
Old selection checked aggregate P/R/F1 and mean countMAE but not per-species or scale-group non-inferiority. A large-object loss was visible before test, even while the aggregate gate passed.

For each image predicted-minus-truth equals FP-minus-FN. Fewer combined detection errors do not guarantee lower absolute count error; cancellations change. Neither MAE alone nor micro AP alone is an adequate promotion gate.

Uniform image sampling and a single collapsed colony class do not balance morphologies/scales. Large/faint training examples exist but are a minority. Scale and morphology shift is plausible; size alone is not proven as the sole cause.

The measured effect is a stronger undercount bias: low-count queries improve, medium/high-count queries worsen. Pixel-mean density MSE versus count objective, frozen representation, count imbalance and short fine-tuning are plausible causes requiring ablation, not established single-cause explanations.

findings.evidence: FamNet sample() consumes3-6 supplied exemplar rectangles; the model does not generate them.
findings.conclusion: More epochs do not remove that input dependency. Treat reference-free/text-guided methods as a separate architecture track; do not substitute ground-truth exemplar boxes while claiming automatic counting.

Training-time validation and final reload/backend reports differ. This does not prove a particular bug. Freeze weightSHA, fixed1024letterbox, FP32, batch and NMS settings when comparing; resolve on validation before claiming export parity. Three Mac photos do not establish iPhone acceptance.

nextExperiment.basis: Preserving full-image predictions alongside slicing is motivated by SAHI; the size gate below is an engineering variant, not a literal paper replication.
nextExperiment.input: Existing whole/tiled validation prediction caches only; no old-test or new-external-test inference.
nextExperiment.fusion: Retain whole-image boxes whose predicted minimum side is at least the cutoff and tile boxes below the cutoff, both measured in full-image1024units. Merge by NMS. This hard split can create size-disagreement gaps/duplicates; record failures rather than expanding the grid after seeing results.
nextExperiment.cost: A deployed version needs1whole+4tile forward passes per image; cache experiment measures postprocessing only and makes no latency claim.
mandatoryReporting: AP50/AP50-95 from complete low-confidence prediction pools
nextExperiment.gates: The accompanying fusion protocol will numerically freeze improvement and non-inferiority gates before any candidate is scored. No threshold relaxation if all candidates fail.

nextTrainingAblationsIfFusionInsufficien.name: species-balanced image sampling
nextTrainingAblationsIfFusionInsufficien.change: Train-only sampler weights approximately inverse images-per-species, normalized and capped0.5to3.0; same epoch-step count/seed/checkpoint rules.
nextTrainingAblationsIfFusionInsufficien.reason: 15train species vary6to35images; avoid dense/common appearance dominance.
nextTrainingAblationsIfFusionInsufficien.limit: Does not create missing diffuse morphology or prove transfer to unseen species.

nextTrainingAblationsIfFusionInsufficien.name: scale-balanced training views
nextTrainingAblationsIfFusionInsufficien.change: Preserve full plates plus bounded train-only crops targeting small-object detail; split by original plate/species before crops. Count cropped partial objects consistently and preserve full-plate large examples.
nextTrainingAblationsIfFusionInsufficien.limit: Need to report total effective training steps; not compare a5x-expanded training corpus to a shorter baseline as an architecture-only gain.

nextTrainingAblationsIfFusionInsufficien.name: count-aware FamNet loss
nextTrainingAblationsIfFusionInsufficien.change: Train/validation-only ablation of original densityMSE plus calibrated count residual; fix the coefficient from train-only gradient/loss scales before tuning. Stratify by count bins and report tail errors.
nextTrainingAblationsIfFusionInsufficien.limit: Reference-box input remains; this is secondary if the product requires automatic target selection.

fairValidationPlan.knownData: Existing train/val may support development, bounded calibration and sensitivity checks. Previously opened colony63/FSC1189 may only be labelled regression/known benchmarks. Do not recycle them into new-blind claims.

newExternalHoldout.acquire: Independent source/capture batches, preferably different lab/camera; reserve original images before any model inference. Root owns acquisition.
newExternalHoldout.initialCoverageTarget: Plan approximately100unique plates/scenes with enough large/diffuse, small/dense and empty/background-negative groups; this is a practical coverage target, not a power guarantee.
newExternalHoldout.grouping: All photographs/crops/rotations/background variants of one physical plate or acquisition batch stay together. Compare source hashes and near-duplicates against all current data.
newExternalHoldout.annotation: Freeze reviewed boxes/counts and any uncertainty masks before predictions; two-person or independent review where feasible. Never alter masks after seeing errors.
newExternalHoldout.conditions: Record camera, illumination, density/morphology and specimen/source metadata when available. Do not treat many views of one plate as independent specimens.

fairValidationPlan.promotionGate: Lock model/config/code/source hashes before new-holdout inference. Require paired improvement in countMAE and species/morphology-macro metrics without materially losing TP or increasing FP in any protected scale group; group-bootstrap CIs by plate/batch, not individual correlated photos. If evidence is insufficient, keep development-only status.
fairValidationPlan.deploymentGate: Separate CoreML/iPhone numerical and sustained runtime verification; do not update the submitted app based on cached-val gains alone.

completedDevelopmentExperiment.conclusion: Averages improved but protection failures remain; development evidence only, no model promotion.
